cues: Five integers written with put w, four bytes each: twenty bytes.
Sequential access reads them in order from the start.
Random access jumps: f seek to two times the size of an int, byte eight, lands on the third number, thirty three.
After reading four bytes, f tell reports position twelve.
The whole idea: offset equals record number times record size.
